indhā̍nāstvā supra̠jasaḥ̍ su̠vīrā̠ jyogjī̍vema bali̠hṛto̍ va̠yante̎||
yanme̍ agne a̠sya ya̠jñasya̠ riṣyā̠ d yadvā̠ skandā̠dājya̍syo̠ta vi̍ṣṇo|
tena̍ hanmi sa̠patna̍ndurmarā̠yumaina̍ndadhāmi̠ nir·ṛ̍tyā u̠pasthe̎|
bhūr bhuvaḥ̠ suva̠rucchu̍ṣmo agne̠ yaja̍mānāyaidhi̠ niśu̍ṣmo abhi̠dāsa̍te|

agne̠ deve̎ddha̠ manvi̍ddha̠ mandra̍ji̠hvāma̍rtyasya te hotarmū̠rddhannā ji̍gharmi rā̠yaspoṣā̍ya suprajā̠stvāya̍ su̠vīryā̍ya̠ mano̍'si prājāpa̠tyammana̍sā mā bhū̠tenā *vi̍śa̠ vāga̍syai̠ndrī sa̍patna̠khṣaya̍ṇī vā̠cā me̎ndri̠yeṇā *vi̍śa vasa̠ntamṛ̍tū̠nāmprī̍ṇāmi̠ sa mā̎ prī̠taḥ prī̍ṇātu grī̠ṣmamṛ̍tū̠nāmprī̍ṇāmi̠ sa mā̎ prī̠taḥ prī̍ṇātu va̠r̠ṣā ṛ̍tū̠nāmprī̍ṇāmi̠ tā mā̎ prī̠tāḥ prī̍ṇantu śa̠rada̍mṛtū̠nāmprī̍ṇāmi̠ sā mā̎ prī̠tā prī̍ṇātu hemantaśiśi̠rāvṛ̍tū̠nāmprī̍ṇāmi̠ tau mā̎ prī̠tau prī̍ṇītāma̠gnīṣoma̍yora̠haṃ de̍vaya̠jyayā̠ cakhṣu̍ṣmān bhūyāsama̠gnera̠hande̍vaya̠jyayā̎'nnā̠do bhū̍yāsa̠

a̠gnirmā̠ duri̍ṣṭāt pātu savi̠tā'ghaśa̍gͫsā̠dyo me'nti̍ dū̠re̍'rātī̠yati̠ tame̠tena̍ jeṣa̠g̠ͫ surū̍pavarṣavarṇa̠ ehī̠mān bha̠drān duryā̍gͫ a̠bhyehi̠ māmanu̍vratā̠ nyu̍ śī̠r̠ṣāṇi̍ mṛḍhva̠miḍa̠ ehyadi̍ta̠ ehi̠ sara̍sva̠tyehi̠ ranti̍rasi̠ rama̍tirasi sū̠narya̍si̠ juṣṭe̠ juṣṭi̍nte'śī̠yopa̍hūta upaha̠va

ba̠r̠hiṣo̠'hande̍vaya̠jyayā̎ pra̠jāvā̎n bhūyāsa̠nnarā̠śagͫsa̍syā̠hande̍vaya̠jyayā̍ paśu̠mān bhū̍yāsama̠gneḥ svi̍ṣṭa̠kṛto̠'hande̍vaya̠jyayā''yu̍ṣmānya̠jñena̍ prati̠ṣṭhāṅga̍meyama̠gnera̠hamujji̍ti̠manūjje̍ṣa̠g̠ͫ soma̍syā̠ha mujji̍ti̠manūjje̍ṣama̠gnera̠hamujji̍ti̠manūjje̍ṣama̠gnīṣoma̍yora̠hamujji̍ti̠manūjje̍ṣamindrāgni̠yora̠hamujji̍ti̠manūjje̍ṣa̠mindra̍syā̠ha su̠retā̠ reto̍ dhiṣīya̠ tvaṣṭu̍ra̠hande̍vaya̠jyayā̍ paśū̠nāgͫ rū̠pampu̍ṣeyande̠vānā̠mpatnī̍ra̠gnir gṛ̠hapa̍tir ya̠jñasya̍ mithu̠nantayo̍ra̠hande̍vaya̠jyayā̍ mithu̠nena̠ prabhū̍yāsavm̐ve̠do̍'si̠ vitti̍rasi vi̠deya̠ karmā̍'si ka̠ruṇa̍masi kri̠yāsa̍gͫ sa̠nira̍si sani̠tā'si̍ sa̠neya̍ṅghṛ̠tava̍ntaṅkulā̠yina̍gͫ rā̠yaspoṣa̍gͫ saha̠sriṇa̍vm̐ve̠do da̍dātu vā̠jina̎m
ā pyā̍yatāndhru̠vā ghṛ̠tena̍ ya̠jñaym̐ya̍jña̠mprati̍ deva̠yadbhyaḥ̍|
sū̠ryāyā̠ ūdho'di̍tyā u̠pastha̍ u̠rudhā̍rā pṛthi̠vī ya̠jñe a̠sminn||

pra̠jāpa̍ter vi̠bhānnāma̍ lo̠kastasmi̍gͫͫstvā dadhāmi sa̠ha yaja̍mānena̠ sada̍si̠ sanme̍ bhūyāḥ̠ sarva̍masi̠ sarva̍mme bhūyāḥ pū̠rṇama̍si pū̠rṇamme̍ bhūyā̠ akhṣi̍tamasi̠ mā me̎ khṣeṣṭhāḥ̠ prācyā̎ndi̠śi de̠vā ṛ̠tvijo̍ mārjayantā̠ndakhṣi̍ṇāyā

aga̍nma̠ suvaḥ̠ suva̍raganma sa̠ndṛśa̍ste̠ mā chi̍thsi̠ yatte̠ tapa̠stasmai̍ te̠ mā''vṛ̍khṣi su̠bhūra̍si̠ śreṣṭho̍ raśmī̠nāmā̍yu̠rddhā a̠syāyu̍rme dhehi varco̠dhā a̍si̠ varco̠ mayi̍ dhehī̠dama̠hama̠mumbhrātṛ̍vyamā̠bhyo di̠gbhyo̎'syai di̠vo̎'smāda̠ntari̍khṣāda̠syai pṛ̍thi̠vyā a̠smāda̠nnādyā̠nnirbha̍jāmi̠ nirbha̍ktaḥ̠ sa yandvi̠ṣmaḥ sañjyoti̍ṣā'bhūvamai̠ndrīmā̠vṛta̍ma̠nvāva̍rte̠ sama̠hampra̠jayā̠ sammayā̎ pra̠jā sama̠hagͫ rā̠yaspoṣe̍ṇa̠ sammayā̍ rā̠yaspoṣaḥ̠ sami̍ddho agne me dīdihi same̠ddhā te̍ agne dīdyāsa̠vm̐vasu̍mānya̠jño vasī̍yān bhūyāsa̠magna̠ āyū̍gͫṣi pavasa̠ ā su̠vorja̠miṣa̍ñca naḥ|
ā̠re bā̍dhasva du̠cchunā̎m||
agne̠ pava̍sva̠ svapā̍ a̠sme varcaḥ̍ su̠vīrya̎m

yathā̠ vai sa̍mṛtaso̠mā e̠vavm̐vā e̠te sa̍mṛtaya̠jñā yadda̍rśapūrṇamā̠sau kasya̠ vā'ha̍ de̠vā ya̠jñamā̠gaccha̍nti̠ kasya̍ vā̠ na ba̍hū̠nāym̐yaja̍mānānā̠ym̐yo vai de̠vatāḥ̠ pūrvaḥ̍ parigṛ̠hṇāti̠ sa e̍nāḥ̠ śvo bhū̠te ya̍jata e̠tadvai de̠vānā̍mā̠yata̍na̠ym̐yadā̍hava̠nīyo̎'nta̠rā'gnī pa̍śū̠nāṅgārha̍patyo manu̠ṣyā̍ṇāmanvāhārya̠paca̍naḥ pitṛ̠ṇāma̠gniṅgṛ̍hṇāti̠ sva e̠vāyata̍ne de̠vatāḥ̠ pari̍ vm̐vā ā̍ra̠ṇyami̍ndri̠yame̠vā''tman dha̍tte̠ yadanā̎śvānupa̠vase̠t khṣodhu̍kaḥ syā̠dyada̍śñī̠yādru̠dro̎'sya pa̠śūna̠bhi ma̍nyetā̠'po̎'śñāti̠ tannevā̍śi̠tannevā'na̍śita̠nna khṣodhu̍ko̠ bhava̍ti̠ nāsya̍ ru̠draḥ pa̠śūna̠bhi ma̍nyate̠ vajro̠ vai ya̠jñaḥ khṣut khalu̠ vai ma̍nu̠ṣya̍sya̠ bhrātṛ̍vyo̠ yadanā̎'śvānupa̠vasa̍ti̠ vajre̍ṇai̠va sā̠khṣāt khṣudha̠mbhrātṛ̍vyagͫ hanti

yo vai śra̠ddhāmanā̍rabhya ya̠jñena̠ yaja̍te̠ nāsye̠ṣṭāya̠ śradda̍dhate̠'paḥ pra ṇa̍yati śra̠ddhā vā āpaḥ̍ śra̠ddhāme̠vā''rabhya̍ ya̠jñena̍ yajata u̠bhaye̎'sya devamanu̠ṣyā i̠ṣṭāya̠ śradda̍dhate̠ tadā̍hu̠rati̠ vā e̠tā vartra̍nneda̠ntyati̠ vāca̠mmano̠ vāvaitā nāti̍ neda̠ntīti̠ mana̍sā̠ pra ṇa̍yatī̠yavm̐vai mano̠ de̠vebhya̍ e̠va pra̍ti̠procya̍ ya̠jñena̍ yajate ju̠ṣante̎'sya de̠vā ha̠vyame̠ṣa vai ya̠jñasya̠ graho̍ gṛhī̠tvaiva ya̠jñena̍ yajate̠ tadu̍di̠tvā vāca̍ym̐yacchati ya̠jñasya̠ dhṛtyā̠ atho̠ mana̍sā̠ vai pra̠jāpa̍tir ya̠jñama̍tanuta̠ mana̍sai̠va tadya̠jñanta̍nute̠ rakhṣa̍sā̠mana̍nvavacārāya̠ yo vai ya̠jñaym̐yoga̠ āga̍te yu̠nakti̍ yu̠ṅkte yu̍ñjā̠neṣu̠ kastvā̍ yunakti̠ sa tvā̍ yuna̠ktvi tyā̍ha pra̠jāpa̍ti̠r vai kaḥ pra̠jāpa̍tinai̠vaina̍ym̐yunakti yu̠ṅkte yu̍ñjā̠neṣu̍

pra̠jāpa̍tir ya̠jñāna̍sṛjatāgniho̠trañcā̎gniṣṭo̠mañca̍ paurṇamā̠sīñco̠kthya̍ñcāmāvā̠syā̎ñcātirā̠traṃ ca̠ tānuda̍mimīta̠ yāva̍dagniho̠tramāsī̠t tāvā̍nagniṣṭo̠mo yāva̍tī paurṇamā̠sī tāvā̍nu̠kthyo̍ yāva̍tyamāvā̠syā̍ tāvā̍natirā̠tro ya e̠vavm̐vi̠dvāna̍gniho̠trañju̠hoti̠ yāva̍dagniṣṭo̠meno̍ pā̠pnoti̠ tāva̠dupā̎''pnoti̠ ya e̠vavm̐vi̠dvān pau̎rṇamā̠sīym̐yaja̍te̠ yāva̍du̠kthye̍nopā̠pnoti̠ tāva̠dupā̎''pnoti̠ ya e̠vavm̐vi̠dvāna̍māvā̠syā̎ym̐yaja̍te̠ yāva̍datirā̠treṇo̍pā̠pnoti̠ tāva̠dupā̎''pnoti parame̠ṣṭhino̠ vā e̠ṣa ya̠jño'gra̍ āsī̠t tena̠ sa pa̍ra̠māṅkāṣṭhā̍magaccha̠t tena̍ pra̠jāpa̍tinni̠ravā̍sāyaya̠t tena̍ pra̠jāpa̍tiḥ para̠māṅkāṣṭhā̍magaccha̠t tenendra̍nni̠ravā̍sāyaya̠t tenendraḥ̍ para̠māṅkāṣṭhā̍magaccha̠t tenā̠'gnīṣomau̍ ni̠ravā̍sāyaya̠t tenā̠gnīṣomau̍ pa̠ramāṅkāṣṭhā̍magacchatā̠ym̐ya e̠vavm̐vi̠dvān da̍rśapūrṇamā̠sau yaja̍te para̠māme̠va kāṣṭhā̎ṅgacchati̠ yo vai prajā̍tena ya̠jñena̠ yaja̍te̠ pra pra̠jayā̍ pa̠śubhi̍r mithu̠nair jā̍yate̠ dvāda̍śa̠ māsāḥ̎ savm̐vathsa̠ro dvāda̍śa dva̠ndvāni̍ darśapūrṇamā̠sayo̠stāni̍ saṃ̠pādyā̠nītyā̍hur va̠thsañco̍pāvasṛ̠jatyu̠khāñcādhi̍ śraya̠tyava̍ ca̠ hanti̍ dṛ̠ṣadau̍ ca sa̠māha̠ntyadhi̍ ca̠ vapa̍te ka̠pālā̍ni̠ copa̍ dadhāti puro̠ḍāśa̍

dhru̠vo̍'si dhru̠vo̍'hagͫ sa̍jā̠teṣu̍ bhūyāsa̠mityā̍ha dhru̠vāne̠vainā̎n kuruta u̠gro̎'syu̠gro̍'hagͫ sa̍jā̠teṣu̍ bhūyāsa̠mityā̠hāpra̍tivādina e̠vainā̎n kurute'bhi̠bhūra̍syabhi̠bhūra̠hagͫ sa̍jā̠teṣu̍ bhūyāsa̠mityā̍ha̠ ya e̠vaina̍mpratyu̠tpipī̍te̠ tamupā̎syate yu̠najmi̍ tvā̠ brahma̍ṇā̠ daivye̠netyā̍hai̠ṣa vā a̠gneryoga̠stenai̠ mana̍sā mā bhū̠tenā''vi̠śetyā̍ha̠ mano̠ vai prā̍jāpa̠tyamprā̍jāpa̠tyo ya̠jño mana̍ e̠va ya̠jñamā̠tman dha̍tte̠ vāga̍syai̠ndrī sa̍patna̠khṣaya̍ṇī vā̠cā me̎ndri̠yeṇā''vi̠śetyā̍hai̠ndrī vai vāgvāca̍me̠vaindrī mā̠tman dha̍tte

yo vai sa̍ptada̠śampra̠jāpa̍tiym̐ya̠jñama̠nvāya̍tta̠vm̐veda̠ prati̍ ya̠jñena̍ tiṣṭhati̠ na ya̠jñād bhra̍gͫśata̠ ā śrā̍va̠yeti̠ catu̍rakhṣara̠mastu̠ śrauṣa̠ḍiti̠ catu̍rakhṣara̠ym̐yajeti̠ dvya̍khṣara̠ym̐ye yajā̍maha̠ iti̠ pañcā̎khṣarandvyakhṣa̠ro va̍ṣaṭkā̠ra e̠ṣa vai sa̍ptada̠śaḥ pra̠jāpa̍tir ya̠jñama̠nvāya̍tto̠ ya e̠vavm̐veda̠ prati̍ ya̠jñena̍ tiṣṭhati̠ na ya̠jñād bhra̍gͫśate̠ yo vai ya̠jñasya̠ prāya̍ṇamprati̠ṣṭhā śrauṣa̠ḍityu̠pāvā̎srā̠gyajetyuda̍naiṣī̠dye yajā̍maha̠ ityupā̍'sadad vaṣaṭkā̠reṇa̍ dogddhye̠ṣa vai sū̠nṛtā̍yai̠ doho̠ ya e̠vavm̐veda̍ du̠ha e̠vainā̎nde̠vā vai sa̠tramā̍sata̠ teṣā̠ndiśo̍'dasya̠nta e̠tāmā̠rdrāmpa̠ṅktima̍paśya̠nnā śrā̍va̠yeti̍ purovā̠tama̍janaya̠nnastu̠ śrauṣa̠ḍitya̠bhragͫ sama̍plāvaya̠n̠yajeti̍ vi̠dyuta̍
indra̍vm̐vo vi̠śvata̠spari̠ havā̍mahe̠ jane̎bhyaḥ|

indra̠vm̐vāṇī̍ranūṣata||
